links.name: Ceylon Tea
links.review: The manufacturer declares Black tea for the exact Ahmad Ceylon 500-g loose-leaf variant. The native front label was visually read as Ceylon Tea / 500 g / LOOSE TEA. Retained CityGross article 101254695_ST has the same full brand/variant/net package; no GTIN is published in that retained row and none is invented. Not Earl Grey, flavoured tea, green tea or counted tea bags; used dry for the authored smoking process, not an infusion yield.
